meta.aciklama: Search legislation, court decisions and board decisions; see the citation, authority class and official source of every result.

giris: Type a question, a concept, an article reference (KVKK m.11, TBK 49) or a docket and decision number.

form.ipucu: For example: deletion of personal data, KVKK m.11, 4. HD 2021/26076 E., 2024/10643 K.
form.mahkemeIpucu: For example: Yargıtay, Hukuk Genel Kurulu, Kişisel Verileri Koruma Kurulu

sonuc.kaynagaGitEtiket: {baslik} opens at its official source in a new tab
sonuc.kaydetHata: Could not save. Please try again.
sonuc.eskiUyari: This source is older than 10 years; check whether it still applies.

neden.kimlik: The number or article you searched for matches this record exactly.
neden.norm: The {atif} in your question appears in this record.
neden.terim: Terms of your question appear in the title or the passage.
neden.anlam: It contains a passage close to your question.

bos.baslik: Type what you want to search for
bos.aciklama: You can search by concept, article reference or docket and decision number.
bos.sonucYokAciklama: Try a broader phrase, remove filters or search the official sites below.

hata.baslik: The search could not be completed
hata.kullanilamaz: Search is not available right now. Please try again in a few minutes.
hata.gecersiz: The search phrase or one of the filters is not valid. Keep the search under 500 characters and pick dates from the calendar.

canli.aciklama: These results were fetched just now from an official search interface and are not in the core index.

fikstur.metin: In this environment search runs on a sample corpus: the full Personal Data Protection Law, Turkish Code of Obligations Art. 49-75, five articles of the Constitution, seven Court of Cassation decisions, one Personal Data Protection Board decision summary and GDPR Art. 1-2. The texts were taken from official sources on 7 November 2026.

taranan.aciklama: Search runs only on records compiled from the official sources below. Decisions are cleared of personal data before indexing.
taranan.mevzuat: Mevzuat Bilgi Sistemi: articles of laws
taranan.kvkk: Personal Data Protection Board: decision summaries

etiketler.yeni: Published or decided in the last 3 years.
etiketler.yerlesik: Published or decided 3 to 10 years ago.
etiketler.eski: Older than 10 years; check whether it still applies.
etiketler.oncu: General assembly, unification or grand chamber decision, or a much cited source.
etiketler.anonimlestirildi: Personal data were masked before display.
etiketler.ilgililik: Closeness recomputed for this search: high, medium or background.
etiketler.guncellik_uyarisi: The legislation was later amended or repealed, or the decision was reversed.
etiketler.canli_kaynak: Fetched live from an official search interface; not in the core index.
etiketler.veri_gunu: The source has not been fetched again for more than 7 days.
etiketler.otorite: The authority class is shown with a shape and text: binding norm, binding decision, high precedent, precedent, limited precedent, administrative decision, doctrine, comparative.

resmi.baslik: Search this question on official sites
resmi.aciklama: Google Scholar and DergiPark open with your question; the other links go to the search page of the institution.
